source: По темам армянских учебников математики для 7 класса

stages.headline: Докажи тождество: 2(a − 3) + 6 = 2a.
stages.customInstructions: The student proves the identity by transforming the left side: a last line equal to the right side, or the words "it is an identity" in any language, is correct.

stages.headline: Докажи тождество: x(x − 4) + 4x = x².
stages.customInstructions: The student proves the identity by transforming the left side: a last line equal to the right side, or the words "it is an identity" in any language, is correct.

stages.headline: Докажи тождество: (a + 2)(a + 3) − a(a + 5) = 6.
stages.customInstructions: The student proves the identity by transforming the left side: a last line equal to the right side, or the words "it is an identity" in any language, is correct.

stages.headline: Найди k, чтобы x(x + k) = x² − 7x было тождеством.
stages.headlineEnglish: Find k so that x(x + k) = x² − 7x is an identity.
stages.problemText: Find k so that x(x + k) = x² − 7x is an identity.

stages.headline: Покажи, что 2x² = (2x)² не является тождеством.
stages.headlineEnglish: Show that 2x² = (2x)² is not an identity.
stages.problemText: Show that 2x² = (2x)² is not an identity.
